The '''Ratamesh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], that contained the planet of [[Ratamesh]].

==History==
The Ratamesh system was explored sometime between [[8000 BBY]] and [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]] during the [[Subterra Period]] to founding of [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma]] and [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. It fell into the area of space known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]].

==Inhabitants==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Ratamesh system boasted a population of 100 to 500 million [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].
